manual_review: Complete reasoning and answer text of the ten selected receipts were inspected locally. They concern abstract concepts and programming/philosophy. No incidental private contact details or credentials were identified in those texts. This is not manual semantic review of every corpus trace.
public_minimization: Full reasoning, reasoning quotations, original raw envelopes, provider response bodies and raw headers are omitted. Released fields are input requests, measurements, timestamps, hashes, classifications and archive references.
limitation: No automated pattern screen can certify the absence of every kind of personal information. This report does not assert permission to redistribute the original archive.
